study.title: MALARIASCOPE: Developing and Benchmarking a Climate-Informed Malaria Forecasting and Geospatial Risk Intelligence System for Force Health Protection in Papua, 2010–2026
study.design: Retrospective ecological spatiotemporal forecasting and geospatial risk-intelligence study
study.author: Muhammad Sobri Maulana

forecasting.note: Balanced panel. Supiori excluded because its 2024 outcome was unavailable.

spatial2025.note: Nine-district 2025 spatial assessment; analytically distinct from forecasting panel.

spatial.interpretation: The supplied permutation result does not establish statistically significant global spatial autocorrelation at α=0.05.

disclaimer: Research Prototype — Retrospective Geospatial Risk Intelligence — Not for Autonomous Clinical Decision-Making or Operational Deployment
